retrievalProfile.description: A centered full-body studio portrait of a woman in a long red dress with arms outstretched, featuring minimalist 1970s geometric typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body studio photograph of a woman with a voluminous afro, wearing a floor-length red long-sleeved dress. She stands centered against a neutral, slightly vignetted grey-blue background with her arms raised diagonally to form a 'V' shape. Thin, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif text is positioned symmetrically on either side of her torso.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered as a vertical anchor
Arms creating a strong diagonal 'V' frame
Typography balanced horizontally across the mid-section
High contrast between the red garment and the cool-toned background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered full-body figure, occupying approximately 80% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's face and the central axis of the red dress.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, follows the arms outward to the text, then down the length of the dress.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample open space in the upper corners and around the lower half of the dress to emphasize the silhouette.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm skin tones and gold jewelry
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation on the central figure against a low-saturation, medium-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single weight geometric sans used for all elements to maintain 70s minimalism.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the quintessential 70s geometric aesthetic and circular forms.
Provides the necessary geometric skeleton and thin stroke.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A full-body studio shot of a woman with a 70s afro hairstyle, wearing a long-sleeved red maxi dress, standing with arms outstretched in a V-shape against a plain grey-blue studio wall. Soft lighting, slight vignette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text in a thin geometric sans-serif font like Avant Garde. Place the artist name on the left and the album title on the right, aligned with the subject's waist, using wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the subject centered with arms forming a diagonal frame?
Is the dress a solid, vibrant red?
Is the font thin, geometric, and widely spaced?
Is the background a neutral, muted tone?

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and album title text
postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness in the outstretched arms.
Ensure the text does not overlap the subject.
Verify the dress reaches the floor without cutting off the feet awkwardly.
Confirm the font weight is consistently thin.
